properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 14 at 12:27PM PDT until October 15 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.areaDesc: Ventura County Beaches; Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor tidal overflow during times of high tides,
dangerous rip currents, and elevated surf.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles
County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding of sea water is likely around high
tide at low-lying beach and harbor areas that is uncommon with
normal tidal ranges. Enhanced beach erosion is possible. The
risk for significant damage is very low. There is an increased
risk of ocean drowning. Rip currents can pull swimmers and
surfers out to sea. Waves can wash people off beaches and
rocks, and capsize small boats nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor tidal overflow during morning high
tide of 6.4 feet.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 14 at 2:03AM PDT until October 15 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.description:
* WHAT...Elevated high tides 6.5 to 7 ft will continue through
Thursday with surf of 3 to 5 ft with sets to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and beach erosion. Dangerous
swimming conditions for inexperienced swimmers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will fall below 6.5 ft after
the Thursday high tide. A south swell from 190 degrees of 3 ft
with a 15 to 17 second period will be present through
Thursday. A moderate period, persistent south swell from 190
will continue into next week.
properties.instruction:
A beach hazards statement for minor tidal overflow means that
high astronomical tides possibly in combination with above normal
surf will likely produce minor flooding of low-lying areas along
the beach such as beach parking lots. Coastal officials should
take the necessary precautionary measures to safeguard their
beaches.

A beach hazards statement is issued when threats such as rip
currents and other hazards are possible.  Caution should be used
when in or near the water.
